current_logic.regime_classification: Unsupervised 5-State TVTP-HMM v53 + Empirical 2D Post-hoc Mapping (μ/σ/Sharpe) + μ Semantic Constraints
current_logic.alpha_generation: ML-based Cross-Sectional Alpha (LightGBM DART, 13-feat HMM input)

key_parameters.hmm_architecture: Unsupervised 5-State TVTP-HMM v53 + Post-hoc Empirical Mapping
key_parameters.hmm_semantic_mapping: Empirical: Viterbi hard labels + emp_mu/emp_sig/Sharpe per latent state

hmm_mapping_rules.crisis: argmin(Sharpe) among high-σ states; override to argmin(emp_mu) if emp_mu[crisis] >= 0
hmm_mapping_rules.bear: argmin(emp_mu) among non-crisis; override to next-min if emp_mu[bear] > 0
hmm_mapping_rules.bull_calm: argmax(Sharpe) among low-σ states; override to argmax(emp_mu[non-crisis]) if emp_mu[bull_calm] <= 0
hmm_mapping_rules.bull_vol_up: higher-σ among remaining two positive-μ states
hmm_mapping_rules.chop: middle-μ among remaining three (after crisis+bear assigned)

key_parameters.hmm_mapping_computed_at: each fit_step on training window returns_ser

best_achieved_metrics.note: Two distinct achievement modes — see known_issues for tradeoff explanation
best_achieved_metrics.best_tail_capture_with_valid_crisis: 35.2% FAIL IS / 35.2% FAIL OOS (Phase3+5, current arch)

known_issues.tc_vs_crisis_semantic_tradeoff: Unconstrained 2D mapping → TC 65.8% but CRISIS μ>0 (parabolic up-move absorbed). μ<0 constraint → TC reverts to ~21-30%. Two objectives fundamentally conflict in post-hoc mapping paradigm.
known_issues.bull_calm_absorbs_tail: BULL_CALM 57.5% time dominance means it absorbs ~54% of worst-5% events. TC structural ceiling ≈35% for CRISIS+BEAR only while BULL_CALM is >50%.
known_issues.vol_up_state_underutilized: BULL_VOL_UP only 2.6% time — parabolic up-move cluster not forming due to insufficient training bars matching (trend+1.5, vol+2.0) init.
known_issues.stacked_mu_constraints_fight: CRISIS+BEAR+BULL_CALM μ constraints interact: BEAR swap reassigns to lower-σ state → reduces tail absorption → TC regresses vs Phase3+5 without patch.
known_issues.ic_consistently_weak: IC |<0.03| across all horizons. HMM posterior does not predict forward returns with useful precision.
known_issues.market_hmm_cache_stale: Early pipeline HMM (Market symbol) cached from Phase3+5; LGB weights unchanged across patch runs. Cache key = (ver + source_file_hash); next version bump will force refresh.
known_issues.chop_45pct_dominance: CHOP 21-45% occupancy (varies by experiment) with moderate σ, absorbs tail events not counted by CRISIS+BEAR metric.

next_recommended_actions: Option A (Hybrid NLL): Reintroduce light μ_return_penalty (weight 200-400) in _compute_nll to soft-guide CRISIS state to negative-mean cluster. Avoid >1000x that killed v2.x. Expected TC: 45-55% with CRISIS semantic intact.

Option B (Metric Redefinition): Accept TC ~35%, shift success metric from TC to Sharpe-ratio gap (BULL_CALM Sharpe vs CRISIS Sharpe). Regime signal quality for portfolio sizing, not just tail isolation.
Option C (Phase1+2 Rollback): Return to 4-state Phase1+2 unconstrained (TC 65.8%) for pure tail-capture use. Rename CRISIS label to 'HIGH_RISK' to avoid semantic confusion.
Option D (Separate CRISIS Filter): Keep 5-state HMM for clustering; add independent CRISIS post-filter (vol spike + drawdown rule-based) to boost TC without contaminating HMM training.
